findings.title: Conflicting street numbers on the official contact page
findings.source: Official website: visible contact page, metadata, and directions link
findings.observation: The visible contact address is 2805 Campus Drive, Suite 475. The same page’s description, Open Graph description, and Google Maps link use 2855 Campus Drive.
findings.limitation: This verifies an inconsistency. It does not establish which street number is current or why an AI engine selected an address.
findings.next_action: Ask the practice owner to confirm the current address, then align the visible page, metadata, and directions link.

findings.title: Google identifies the practice in this branded query
findings.observation: The captured AI Overview names service groups, cites the official website, and gives 2805 Campus Drive. The practice is present in this response.
findings.limitation: One branded query does not measure ranking or unbranded discoverability. The response’s claim about pricing was not verified across the full website.
findings.next_action: Repeat a predefined query set in documented sessions after the address is confirmed; preserve favorable and unfavorable outcomes.

findings.title: A WebSite JSON-LD block is present on the homepage
findings.source: Local inspection of three fetched public HTML pages
findings.observation: The homepage contains one syntactically valid JSON-LD block of type WebSite. No JSON-LD blocks were detected in the fetched contact or services HTML. No microdata itemtypes or RDFa typeof attributes were detected in these snapshots.
findings.limitation: Syntax and inventory checks are not full Schema.org semantic validation. The external validator requested human verification. Results are limited to these three snapshots and do not imply that missing markup prevents an AI response.
findings.next_action: Complete semantic validation and evaluate any business or service markup against owner-confirmed facts.

findings.title: An explicit online booking link is available
findings.observation: The contact page contains a Book Appointment Online link to an external scheduling service, as well as a published telephone number.
findings.limitation: The presence and destination of the link were observed. Scheduling availability and a completed booking were not tested.
findings.next_action: Check the scheduling destination through to appointment selection without submitting a real appointment.
